headline: India reviewing Dhaka's request to extradite former PM Sheikh Hasina
summary: The Indian Ministry of External Affairs has confirmed that the request for the extradition of the ousted Bangladeshi leader is under examination.
details: India's Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal announced that the Indian government is currently reviewing the request from Dhaka to extradite former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
Sheikh Hasina resigned from her position and left Bangladesh for India in August 2024 following widespread protests and a mass uprising against her government.
The current interim government of Bangladesh has been seeking the return of the former leader to face legal proceedings in Dhaka.
The decision on whether to grant the extradition request will depend on the legal frameworks and treaties between the two neighboring countries.
caption:
India is now examining a request from Dhaka to bring back former PM Sheikh Hasina.

India's Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal announced that the Indian government is currently reviewing the request from Dhaka to extradite former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

Sheikh Hasina resigned from her position and left Bangladesh for India in August 2024 following widespread protests and a mass uprising against her government.

The current interim government of Bangladesh has been seeking the return of the former leader to face legal proceedings in Dhaka.

The decision on whether to grant the extradition request will depend on the legal frameworks and treaties between the two neighboring countries.

headline: 60 kmph winds: Storm warning issued for 16 districts
summary: Heavy rain and thunderstorms with winds up to 60 kmph are expected in several regions across the country.
details: Storm warnings have been issued for 16 districts across Bangladesh, with wind speeds expected to reach up to 60 kmph.
The weather forecast indicates a high probability of thunderstorms and heavy rainfall in these affected regions.
Residents in the risk zones are advised to take necessary precautions to ensure safety during the sudden weather shift.
Authorities are monitoring the situation closely to mitigate potential risks associated with the strong winds and rain.
